notes: V31 (CR 606.6, 704.5i): Basri Ket at exactly 2 loyalty can activate his -2. Paying it leaves 0 loyalty counters, so he is put into his owner's graveyard, and his loyalty counters cease to exist (CR 122.2); he must never be reset to his printed 3. (The -2's 'this turn' attack trigger is compiled as a grant to Basri, so it dies with him; that is a separate, weaker-than-printed finding, not asserted here.)
